title: The Crowning with Thorns: Third Sorrowful Mystery
summary: Pray the Third Sorrowful Mystery page by page: the story of the Crowning with Thorns, the Gospel, the decade prayers, and a quiet reflection.
coverAlt: Titian's painting of the Crowning with Thorns: soldiers press a crown of thorns onto Jesus' head.

pages.title: The Crowning with Thorns
pages.body: The soldiers pressed a crown of thorns onto Jesus' head and mocked him as a king. He is a true King, but his throne is the cross and his crown is love. As we pray this decade, we ask for courage when others laugh at what is good.
pages.imageAlt: Titian's painting of the Crowning with Thorns: soldiers press a crown of thorns onto Jesus' head.

evidence.claim: Original child-friendly meditation on the mystery; the mystery and its traditional day follow the standard Rosary order.

pages.title: From the Gospel
pages.body:
God's Word tells us this mystery. From the Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 27 (Douay-Rheims Bible):

“And stripping him, they put a scarlet cloak about him. And platting a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand. And bowing the knee before him, they mocked him, saying: Hail, king of the Jews.”

(Matthew 27:27-29)

evidence.claim: Scripture quotation reproduced word for word from the Douay-Rheims 1899 American Edition (public domain); verse numbers omitted for reading aloud and ellipses mark skipped verses.

pages.title: Praying the Decade
pages.body:
We announce the mystery: The Crowning with Thorns, the Third Sorrowful Mystery. Then we pray one decade of the Rosary, holding this scene in our hearts.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. (We pray the Hail Mary ten times, once for each bead of the decade.)

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit; as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy.

evidence.claim: The Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be and Fatima prayers use the standard formulas printed across this site.

pages.title: The Fruit of This Mystery: Moral courage and humility
pages.body:
This mystery grows the fruit of moral courage and humility. The soldiers laughed at Jesus. Have you ever been laughed at for doing right? Jesus understands.

Let us pray: Lord Jesus, give us courage when faithfulness costs us something. Amen. Our Lady of the Rosary, pray for us.

evidence.claim: Original reflection and closing prayer; the fruit of the mystery follows the traditional list used across this site.
